candidates.prediction_prompt: 中央を外すと、橋と通れる場所はどう変わると思う？
observe_before: Actual beam and two bridge shapes in normal view
What information supports the stated prediction: terrain, small sign, Z guide, prior memory
observe_after: Center support disappears and two curves become one lower path
Whether player can identify the changed clearance and proceed under the beam using normal input
candidates.counterexample: Can execute F from the guide without predicting why lowering helps; pressing F alone is not causal understanding.
candidates.minimum: One uninterrupted ordinary-input attempt from two completed bridges through F and, if successful, the beam. Before F ask for a prediction; immediately after ask what changed and how to proceed. Ask the reason for passage only after actual passage. Existing diagnostics are not this trial.
candidates.value_condition: Candidate value increases if the player predicts/then explains the same cause and can continue; decreases if only a memorized F sequence is reproduced.

candidates.prediction_prompt: 上と下は、何を使い、何が難しそう？どこを見て選ぶ？
observe_before: Whether both route entries are visible when deciding
Recognition of green bridge endpoints versus blue swing hooks
Resource and selected-length HUD reading before commitment
observe_after: Upper Q cost feedback versus lower E attachment without spend
Whether the player can explain the remaining resource difference at the merge
Target halo/rope appearance and whether a missed next connection can be explained
candidates.counterexample: A player could choose the upper path because it appears nearer or familiar, learning the cost only afterward. An actual tradeoff was then not predicted.
candidates.minimum: Observe an initial attempt with a pre-action question; do not label it an unguided natural choice. If both routes are compared, reproduce the same entry state by ordinary play, record entry/merge resource and failures, and stop if state cannot be matched. No teleport/reset of internal variables.
candidates.value_condition: Keep as a showcase if a reasoned predicted tradeoff remains legible after the result; if not, compare outcome/cost prediction wording before adding route content.

candidates.prediction_prompt: 長さを変えると、トゲの上の通り方はどう変わりそう？
observe_before: Hook above three spikes and landing banks
World-sign safe/danger paths and optional Z diagram
Selected next length and attached state in HUD
observe_after: A changed swing clearance and actual landing
If contact occurs: spike contact, detachment and subsequent motion in a continuous ordinary-input recording
Whether failure is attributed to length, aim, acceleration or manual release
candidates.counterexample: Guide gives 6–7. Following that number without predicting the path can pass the lesson while showing little choice or understanding.
candidates.minimum: Observe an initial attempt with a pre-action question; do not label it an unguided natural choice. Then compare selected 8 and 6 if normal retries permit, keeping start/aim/acceleration/release as similar as practical; record differences and do not claim deterministic identical inputs. Do not require a death.
candidates.value_condition: Keep a brief showcase if changing length visibly supports a corrected prediction; otherwise retain as learning but do not use it to promise the central appeal.
